Most patients with DILE have 1 or more clinical symptoms of SLE, such as arthralgias, lymphadenopathy, rash, and fever, and have had no prior history of autoimmune disease. However, certain manifestations typical in persons with SLE are not usually observed in persons with DILE. No specific criteria establish the diagnosis of DILE, and excluding underlying autoimmune disease is not a simple process.
